title: One opening-date constant, with the year, drives the home band, pill, beta copy and quick answers
detail:
OPENING_DATE_ISO has no consumers; the home band says December 1 with no year and comments still say January 1. Use one constant everywhere and fix lib/core/beta-notices.ts.

2026-10-26: OPENING_DATE_LABEL already carries the year in every answer and door FAQ. The home beta band still reads BETA_ENDS_LABEL (December 1, no year) because SCAN-885, LIVE-1304 and LIVE-1312 pin that. Showing the year there needs those pins changed, which needs the owner's go-ahead.

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
